payload.limitations: A small deterministic synthetic protocol from unconditioned weights. No biological calibration, learning advantage, full Potter reproduction, population confidence interval, or hardware evidence. Prebuilt binary identity is retained; source-to-binary reproducibility is not established here. The revised interval is estimated from three seeds and is a heuristic, not calibrated probabilistic uncertainty. Seeds 2301-2303 are held out from the discovery fit.

model.prediction_rule: For a new three-seed mean, use discovery mean plus or minus three discovery sample SDs as a falsifiable heuristic; this is not a confidence interval.
model.statement: The short unconditioned synthetic protocol has a small mean plastic-weight effect with seed-dependent sign; model the effect by the measured mean and between-seed variation instead of a uniformly positive lower bound.

payload.next_test: For a claim beyond the quick protocol, preregister a larger independent seed set and a full-size culture/horizon comparison. Do not infer biological learning or population coverage from this check.
